menus.name: Whispers of the Rainforest tasting menu
menus.note: Eight courses with side dishes; wine pairing or combined wine and drinks pairing €160, non-alcoholic pairing €140; vegetarian version on request

bookingOpens: Online on the restaurant's website: choose the date, time and party size. Phone lines are open Tuesday to Friday, 10am to 2pm.
cancellation: A credit card guarantees the booking. Cancel or change numbers free of charge up to 48 hours ahead, in writing by email; later cancellations, fewer guests or no-shows may be charged the guarantee amount per person.
waitlist: When a date is fully booked, you can join the waiting list on the website.
groups: Small groups are welcome; for larger or exclusive bookings, email the team. Group offers may require a 75% deposit due seven working days before.
